target: scaffold.sh manifest — every source path it claims actually ships in the plugin (guards manifest/init drift)
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/scaffold.sh"; MISSING=""; while IFS=$'\t' read -r dest src tier; do [ -n "$src" ] || continue; [ -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/$src" ] || MISSING="$MISSING $src"; done < <(scaffold_manifest software-unattended); jq -n --arg missing "$MISSING" --arg n "$(scaffold_manifest software-unattended | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" '{missing: $missing, count: $n}'
